context: Kenji and Aoi celebrate their baby's first month at home quietly.
purpose: New parents adjusting to family life sweetly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: A month already. Can you believe it?
lines.style: Soft, marveling wonder on the opening. Warm, almost protective tone. Speaking to herself as much as to him. Brief pause before the realization lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Time really does fly, doesn't it.
lines.style: Gentle agreement with a Kansai lilt. Fond, almost nostalgic. Slow, savoring pace. Eyes crinkling at the corners without needing to look at her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: You can see it changing every single day.
lines.style: Quiet pride underlying every word. Soft, present tone — noticing the small things. Speaking from close observation. Slight lift at the end, like sharing something she's treasured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一緒におる時間、宝物や。
lines.en: The time we spend together — that's the real treasure.
lines.style: Tender Kansai warmth. Unhurried, deliberate. Light emphasis on 「一緒に」, like the togetherness is what matters most. Voice settles lower, intimate.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I'm grateful. Every single day, I really am.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude without performance. Soft and earnest. Slight breath before the second half, like she's making sure he knows she means it. Humble, not self-diminishing.
